thread_text:
sara: :rotating_light: Getting multiple customer reports of 5xx / timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu-west-1 over the past 45m. Customers report request timeouts and intermittent 503s. Customer IDs: org-824, org-199. Saw increase in support tickets + pager.

tom: oncall here, looking. Any recent deploys or config changes? I see a spike starting ~40m ago.

alexm: deploy of edge-proxy v2.4.1 completed 50m ago to eu clusters. Not a full rollout but canary finished ~47m.

priya: support dug up example curl from org-824: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \n https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'` -> 504 gateway timeout.

chen: logs show a pileup of auth-proxy timeouts to KMS around same time, 2000ms+ latencies on token validation. We're seeing connection pool exhaustion on auth-proxy pods.

sara: customers are asking for ETA and mitigation. Can we enable fallback model routing or increase retry windows? org-199 is on dedicated SLA tier, high priority.

tom: immediate mitigations: 1) temp increase auth-proxy replicas in eu (scaling now), 2) enable fallback routing to prequant rwd-small for slow requests, 3) bump client-side timeouts where safe. Starting scale now.

ops-bot: autoscaler: replicas for auth-proxy-eu increased from 3 to 8 by tom at 171999 + 900s.

jess: heads-up: rolling back edge-proxy 2.4.1 would lose some perf fixes. Recommend canary rollback only in eu. We can toggle canary weight to 0 for eu traffic now.

alexm: toggled canary weight -> 0 for eu at 1720000005. Monitoring.

chen: connection pools are draining, 5xx rate reduced after scale and canary toggle. Still seeing some auth latencies (KMS throttles). We're contacting KMS team.

priya: support message draft for org-824 / org-199: "We're actively mitigating an EU service disruption affecting inference; we have scaled auth proxies and reverted a recent edge canary. We're monitoring — will follow up with timeline and root cause." Ack from customers requested.

sara: thanks. Can someone capture repro steps and logs for postmortem? Need minimal repro that support can use and a list of action items.

tom: repro steps I have: 1) hit chat endpoint with burst >200 req/s using valid API key, 2) force auth-proxy CPU high (simulate with tcpdump in staging), 3) observe 504s when auth lat >1s. Saved logs to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1719999999/

alexm: noting correlation: KMS rate limit increases when auth-proxy concurrency >300. We need circuit-breaker tuning to avoid cascading 5xx. Also backlog on batcher seems to increase tail latency.

chen: immediate postmortem action items (assign): - increase auth-proxy connection pool and backpressure limits (alexm) - add KMS retry with exponential backoff + jitter (chen) - add synthetic canary that includes auth + kms flow for eu (jess) - improve observability: token validation histogram + alerts (tom) - customer comms follow-up & SLA credits plan (sara/priya)

priya: I added customers to private update list and scheduled 30m follow-up. Will draft SLA credit options after root cause confirmed.

sara: timeline notes for postmortem: incident start 1719999600 (rough), mitigations applied 1720000000-1720000100, partial recovery 1720000500, final stabilization 1720001700. We'll run postmortem tomorrow 0900 UTC. Add any other blockers here.

jess: agree. Also propose adding a canary pre-flight that runs auth+kms call chain before traffic weight increases. Avoid canary that bypasses auth path.

alexm: long-term: consider moving token validation caching closer to edge to reduce KMS dependency for short-lived tokens.

sara: good. I'll create a postmortem doc and assign owners to those items. Thanks everyone, please add any logs or short notes to the s3 dump path and slack thread. :thumbsup:
